changelog:
-Driver Cards — Added detailed driver profile cards with current season standings and results.

-Pitwall News Feed — Introduced a news section to the Pitwall tab to keep you up to date.

-Settings Menu — Added a dedicated Settings screen for personalization and app preferences.

-Qualifying Times Fix — Resolved bugs causing incorrect lap and sector time formatting in qualifying.

-Standings & Substitutions Fix — Fixed championship standings calculation issues triggered by mid-season driver swaps.

-UI Polish — Minor interface refinements and cosmetic tweaks across the app.
